disambiguation: Not a full OpenAPI validator or request runner; it is a read-only viewer for local specification files.
extras: Pro features (writing notes, saving bookmarks) require GitHub Sponsors.
intentEvidence: Local API Reference opens a JSON or YAML OpenAPI file from your vault in a read-only view.
problem: Developers need a way to inspect local OpenAPI specifications, including endpoints and schemas, without running a live server or using external tools.
summary: Local API Reference allows users to open and view local OpenAPI specification files within the vault, detailing endpoints, parameters, and responses.
